sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five games (four wins and a draw) and sit atop the table with 22 points from 10 matches. Alsager arrive in poor form, having won just once in their last six outings and sitting bottom of the division with only 4 points.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's stronger sides; Eccleshall are currently sixth after a recent loss but remain competitive. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter. Bilston Town (5th) face Foley Meir (13th) at home, with the visitors looking to build on their recent win. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a battle between mid-table sides, while struggling Crewe visit Allscott Heath. Brereton Social welcome winless Widnes Town in what should be a more comfortable fixture for the home side. Shawbury United, in poor form with one win in their last six, travel to Barnton; and Cheadle Heath Nomads, on four games without a win, visit Telford Town in a basement battle.
